headline: Sony Lifts Full-Year Operating Income Guidance by 15%
summary: Tokyo-based Sony raised its operating income guidance by 15% to ¥1.87 trillion for the fiscal year through March, fueled by strong growth in its gaming division and Spider-Man releases.
why: Upward earnings revisions by major entertainment and electronics conglomerates reflect robust consumer demand for gaming and digital content.

impacts.name: Sony Group Corporation
impacts.why: Sony raised its full-year operating income guidance by 15% following strong gaming results.
